scope: Extend schema-aware PostgreSQL domain-over-enum proof one level beyond the 300-domain checkpoint
contract: The existing reusable domain-over-enum contract now includes a 301-level schema-aware case, in addition to its established depth cases through 300.

At depth 301, catalog enum-leaf metadata, keyed edits, draft inserts, typed filters, invalid-label refusal, SQL NULL preservation, transaction writes, rollback and outer pg_typeof values are checked with a same-named shadow enum leading search_path.
Raw inferred text and SQL NULL remain explicitly refused at depths of 64 or more; the new case does not extend that parameter boundary or establish a maximum supported schema-aware depth.

focused_test.result: 1 passed; the contract covers 14 depths, including 301

remaining: Depths beyond 301, other PostgreSQL enum/session combinations, additional array families and consumers, and the wider B3 matrix remain open; this case does not qualify 0.2.0.
